entries.purpose.title: Welcome to Rinda
entries.purpose.body: Rinda helps you learn about everyday habits that affect your health. It is educational, not a diagnosis, and it is not an emergency service. You can skip any question.
entries.neutral.title: You can close this page.
entries.email.report.subject: Your Rinda check-up summary
entries.email.report.greeting: Hello. Here is a summary of your latest Rinda check-up. Each area is looked at on its own.
entries.email.report.disclaimer: This summary is educational, not a diagnosis, and Rinda is not an emergency service. If you feel unwell or worried, talk to a health worker.
entries.email.report.open: Open Rinda to read the full explanation
entries.email.report.optout: You get this email because you switched on email reports in your Rinda Profile. You can switch them off there at any time.
